rmt-2004-alg-04.title: Factor
rmt-2004-alg-04.body:
The equations are $(x-7)(y-3)=6$, $(x-7)(z-2)=6$, $(y-3)(z-2)=4$. Multiplying, $\left[(x-7)(y-3)(z-2)\right]^2=144$, so the product is $\pm12$, giving $x-7=\pm3$, $y-3=\pm2$, $z-2=\pm2$ (same signs). The negative choice gives $z=0$, not allowed. So $x=10$, $y=5$, $z=4$.

**Answer: $(x,y,z)=(10,5,4)$**

rmt-2004-alg-06.title: Add rates
rmt-2004-alg-06.body:
Per hour they clean $\frac13+\frac1{10}+\frac1{15}=\frac{10+3+2}{30}=\frac12$ of the room, so together they need 2 hours.

**Answer: 2 hours**

rmt-2004-alg-07.title: Sign chart
rmt-2004-alg-07.body:
The critical points are $0,1,2,3,4,5$, and the expression changes sign at each (all are simple). For $x<0$ numerator and denominator are both negative, so the quotient is positive. Moving right it alternates: negative on $(0,1)$, positive on $(1,2)$, negative on $(2,3)$, positive on $(3,4)$, negative on $(4,5)$, positive for $x>5$. (At 1, 3, 5 it is undefined; at 0, 2, 4 it equals 0.)

**Answer: $0<x<1$, $2<x<3$, $4<x<5$**
